name: adapter
description: Implements the Adapter pattern in TypeScript: converting interfaces between incompatible systems with minimal coupling.

capabilities.name: typescript
capabilities.description: Implement and test Adapter pattern examples.

examples.input: Wrap a legacy order API behind a modern interface.
examples.output: Creates a LegacyOrderAdapter implementing the OrderSource interface and verifies translation with unit tests.

examples.input: Swap payment providers without touching checkout code.
examples.output: Implements a new PaymentGateway adapter and swaps the wiring at the composition root.
